newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General H1 premium income rises.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General H1 premium income rises.

text.p: British insurance group Legal & General said on Wednesday its new UK equivalent premium income in the first six months of 1997 rose 24 percent to 175 million stg.
The group said its world-wide new equivalent premium income was up 16 percent to 215 million stg.
It said its UK investment management business continued to perform well adding 2.3 billion stg of new pension funds under management.
It now manages 50 billion stg of funds world-wide.
Legal & General's share price opened firm at its overnight close of 434 pence.
